name: WELLGES
summary: Inset-card spa site in bone, near-black moss and pale sage, mixing tight grotesk headlines with italic serif accent phrases and rich layered motion.

fonts.pairing: tight medium-weight grotesk headlines with an italic Instrument Serif phrase finishing each heading; Inter for body and caps labels

signature: every heading splits into upright grotesk plus a sage or moss italic serif tail
full-width rounded inset cards with 12px page gutter for hero, services and CTA
sage marquee band under the hero mixing sans and italic serif
giant edge-to-edge wordmark at the foot of the dark footer
imagery: warm editorial spa and tea photography, soft skin-tone portraits, botanical stills, misty landscapes
layout_grid: 1120px content, 12px gutter for inset full-width cards, 120-160px top padding per section, 4-column highlight cards, 3-column pricing
